verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs say a single call ingests data, extracts entities, and builds a knowledge graph stored as permanent graph memory. Optional RDF/OWL ontologies link extracted entity types and mentions to canonical concepts, and recall() automatically picks a retrieval strategy for each query. Founders report graph, vector and relational storage of entities and connections, plus 87% accuracy on the multi-hop HotpotQA benchmark. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-hop answer quality (the benchmark figures are founder-reported), and in-depth docs on relationship-typed graph traversal and entity-centric query modes.
